facts: Census output area and postcode files report gigabit-capable coverage but omit full-fibre coverage because of commercial confidentiality
Full-fibre fields are documented only for LAUA, pcon and devcon
official_source_candidates.guard: Treat absent OA/postcode full-fibre fields as documented non-publication; never infer them from gigabit, parent geography or provider data.

facts: Coverage figures are fixed-line only unless FWA is explicitly named in the field description
official_source_candidates.guard: Attach a technology scope to every metric and reject silent fixed-plus-FWA aggregation.

facts: Postcode files provide a no-space postcode and a single-space postcode representation
Postcode area is also supplied
official_source_candidates.guard: Normalize only after proving the two postcode forms and area are mutually consistent; retain raw values.

facts: All Matched Premises are premises matched to at least one fixed provider record with non-zero predicted download speed
Unmatched premises are unclassified
All Premises and All Matched Premises counts are absent from postcode files
official_source_candidates.guard: At non-postcode levels require matched not to exceed all premises and derive unclassified only from verified counts; never reconstruct the partition at postcode level.

facts: PARENT_UPRN is optional and identifies the parent BLPU when a parent-child relationship exists
UPRN is mandatory
official_source_candidates.guard: Require a present parent to resolve to a distinct BLPU in the same proven supply lineage; reject self-links and cycles without collapsing child records.

facts: X/Y position is British National Grid and must be populated when COUNTRY=M
Latitude/longitude is ETRS89 and mandatory
CSV/GPKG allow nullable X/Y outside the documented country condition
official_source_candidates.guard: Validate atomic coordinate pairs, country-specific BNG presence and CRS labels; never mix BNG and ETRS89 ordinates.

facts: RPC is mandatory and describes positional accuracy
Local custodian code is mandatory and identifies the authority responsible for maintenance
Islands custodian codes are a separate list from GB AddressBase codes
official_source_candidates.guard: Pin RPC and the dated Islands custodian lookup; do not interpret a custodian as owner or RPC as legal-boundary accuracy.

facts: START_DATE, LAST_UPDATE_DATE and ENTRY_DATE are mandatory; END_DATE is optional
Logical status distinguishes live, provisional and historic records
ADDRESSBASE_POSTAL can identify mail-capable addresses not present in Royal Mail PAF
official_source_candidates.guard: Validate lifecycle ordering and preserve provisional/historic states; AddressBase postal status is not PAF membership, occupancy or broadband evidence.

facts: CONFIDENCE is mandatory text with exactly three documented meanings: version information is correct, potentially changed, or changed
The value may be constant for some relationship packages
official_source_candidates.guard: Reject numeric probability coercion and unknown labels; a constant confidence column is not duplicate-row evidence.

facts: VERSION_NUMBER_1/2 and VERSION_DATE_1/2 are independently optional where unavailable
Both identifiers and confidence are mandatory
official_source_candidates.guard: Preserve null version metadata without dropping the relationship; never fabricate version numbers or dates.

facts: The versions JSON has a mandatory CSV filename, product publication date in YYYY/MM and product publication name in Epoch N form
Identifier1Source and Identifier2Source each carry product, publication, feature-type and identifier-type metadata
Source publication epoch name is optional when null
official_source_candidates.guard: Require the JSON filename to equal the packaged CSV and validate both source identities against the relationship ID; quarantine mixed-epoch or mismatched manifests.

facts: Poly_ID is the unique spatial-object reference
Vers_No is the version of Poly_ID
Rec_Status is mandatory with A, C or D
INSERT is initial creation date and UPDATE is last update date
official_source_candidates.guard: Keep Poly_ID stable across versions, require nondecreasing Vers_No and UPDATE not before INSERT; preserve status instead of overwriting history.

facts: Each polygon geometry must be a single area
Every registered title has at least one index polygon and a title may have multiple polygons
Title_No is mandatory
official_source_candidates.guard: Reject multipart geometry in one Poly_ID while preserving one-to-many Title_No-to-Poly_ID relationships; never dissolve polygons into an exact legal parcel.

facts: Title-UPRN links exist only where HMLR can relate its title address to an AddressBase address
Duplicate address states and missing LRPG transfers can leave one side without the other
One title can associate with many UPRNs
The delivery is full plus validation with no COU
official_source_candidates.guard: Classify missing edges as linkage non-evidence, preserve all proven edges and never invent a COU or infer no title/no address.
